{"id":1575314214,"question_id":2665,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1742103125,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1575314214/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Time to Repair Cars","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool ispossible(vector<int>& ranks, int cars, int mid)\n    {\n        long long repaired_cars = 0;\n        for(int i =0  ; i<ranks.size() ;i++)\n        {\n            int rank = ranks[i];\n            repaired_cars += sqrt(mid / rank);\n                \n            if(repaired_cars >= cars) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    long long repairCars(vector<int>& ranks, int cars) {\n        long long s = 1;\n        long long hr = *max_element(ranks.begin() , ranks.end());\n        long long e = hr * (long long)(cars * cars);\n        int ans = -1;\n\n        while(s<=e)\n        {\n            long long mid = s +(e-s)/2;\n            if(ispossible(ranks,cars,mid))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else\n                s = mid + 1;\n        } \n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-time-to-repair-cars","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":455}
